routes.mount: SafeRoute name=APIKeys; lazy import at line 257

purpose: Manage API credentials for programmatic integrations and identity-bound app sign-in.
primaryGoal: Review loaded key identity, permission and lifecycle information; safely create, revoke or permanently delete a key.

dataSources.behavior: Query key ['api-keys']; AbortSignal forwarded; safeArray selection; ordering originates from created_at DESC. Redacted list has no full secret. A missing database or query failure can return HTTP 200 with an empty array; scan failures can omit individual rows. There is no server observation-time field.
dataSources.wireContract: internal\api\apikey\handler.go:88-97 uses numeric int64 id, snake_case key_prefix/created_at/last_used_at/expires_at, optional subject. web\src\types\admin.ts:1-11 uses camelCase aliases and declares id as string. web\src\api\client.ts:284-288 documents exposing both field-name forms, not numeric-to-string conversion.

dataSources.behavior: Trimmed name, permission and optional app_token; requiresLiveMode, networkMode always, list invalidation and localized success/error toast. Server validates name and permissions; app binding requires admin and a forward-auth identity, rejects app-token callers. Raw key is returned once and remains dialog-local.
Both require live mode; both invalidate inventory and toast results; SudoCanceledError suppresses mutation error toast. Server routes require sudo. Audit issued no requests or mutations.
Mounted only when create dialog opens; ['auth','mode']; 5-minute stale time, no interval/focus refetch; dialog enables app sign-in only for forward_auth.

Retains failed-refresh payloads and pauses as stale; distinguishes fatal initial failures. Offline/as-of mode disables writes and closes create/delete dialogs. No workspace date or vehicle filter belongs on this inventory page.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Inventory and permission panels intentionally repeat fatal-error and retained retry treatment for one source (second branch at 189). Existing SourceContent already owns retained messaging. This is not evidence for another query-state component.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse SourceContent; consider a page-local derived source-state variable only if it preserves both persistent sections and independent recovery placement.

responsive.sourceStrategy: Page min-w-0/full-width adapter; single column until xl, inventory spans two of three columns; key cards split only at 2xl. Card labels and prefix wrap, metadata flex-wrap. Modal body uses constrained secret surface.

issues.detail: Page grid uses viewport xl/2xl thresholds while layout adapters expose container sizing. Narrow allocated content at a wide viewport can still force the supporting column and two-card grid; actual clipping is unverified.
issues.fix: Use existing container-aware layout/card-grid policy if acceptance demonstrates insufficient allocated width; preserve all supporting content.

issues.detail: Key icon, identity and two fixed 44px controls share one non-wrapping top row. Long labels wrap, but 320px card space may leave identity very narrow.
issues.fix: Test actual narrow allocation and long localized names; reflow existing actions below identity when needed without dropping prefix, ownership or lifecycle detail.

sourceStrengths: Localized labels and meaningful icon-only revoke/delete names include fallback key name.
Decorative icons aria-hidden; permission labels/icons supplement color.
Card actions explicitly 44x44; layout panels have labelled titles; retained notice uses polite status.
Canonical fields and overlay components are reused, not replaced.

issues.detail: Create uses size sm (shared Button h-9 = 36px); dialog Done/Generate/Cancel do too at CreateApiKeyModal.tsx:112,149,157. These fall below the contract's stronger 44px mobile default; WCAG spacing-exception compliance is not measured.
issues.fix: Use existing Button sizing/class/wrapLabel APIs to achieve reachable 44px mobile controls; verify spacing and long translated labels.

issues.detail: Expired state dims the entire card to opacity-60, including readable metadata and enabled Delete control. Effective contrast may degrade on both themes; no measured contrast failure claimed.
issues.fix: Convey expiry with existing danger Badge and restrained surface treatment, avoiding parent opacity on actionable/readable content; measure actual composed contrast.

accessibility.keyboardFocusScreenReaderContrast: UNVERIFIED. No browser, focus-trap, clipboard, reveal, sudo or assistive-technology exercise.

states.initialLoading: Four key skeletons and access skeleton; summary undefined raw values until hasData, loading flag suppresses fabricated measurements.
states.empty: Two informative empty panels; create remains header-owned and guarded. Guidance stays visible.
states.fatalError: QueryError and retry in inventory and access sections; summary remains mounted with unknown raw values.
states.retainedStale: SourceContent retains cards and counts with notice/retry in both sections; summary reports retained; PageContainer adds DataFreshnessAuto.
states.offlineReadOnly: OperationalWriteNotice and disabled creation/card controls; mode change closes create/delete dialogs. HTTP mutations additionally requiresLiveMode.
states.mutation: Create/revoke/delete have pending state and hook-owned localized toasts; delete keeps confirmation until success, create transitions to local masked one-time key.

issues.detail: Auth-mode loading and failure are indistinguishable from open mode: canBindApp false silently hides App sign-in. Dialog does not present authMode loading/error/retry or retained-source trust.
issues.fix: Add source-local capability loading/error/retry via existing feedback/data-state components; preserve normal device-key form and safe app-binding gate. Do not invent capability truth while unknown.

issues.detail: Successful [] produces keysState.status ok, not empty; AdminSummary reports Sources loaded although both derived panels are empty. Counts are correctly zero for that returned inventory, but source health is not proven because backend can conceal failures as [].
issues.fix: Distinguish resolved empty inventory in summary copy; keep unavailable/failed backend health explicitly unknown unless API supplies evidence. Do not change existing server forgiving semantics as a cosmetic migration.

states.runtimeAcceptance: UNVERIFIED; APIKeysPage.test.tsx:379-407 contains retained-refresh preservation expectations but was not executed.

visualIssues.detail: Permission chip applies neonColorMap background/ring and fixed 300-level text (tokens.ts:21-25); repeated card icon containers also use this map. Tints are bounded, but their neon/saturated families still add decorative color noise and need theme review.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse or extend existing Badge/IconBox semantic subdued treatment; retain distinct permission label and icon, unknown handling and forced-color outline. No new status registry or saved-theme reset.

visualIssues.detail: Permission bars hardcode green/amber/purple hex fills (also lines 41,50) and default MetricBar gradient; categorical permissions are not measured health/severity. These compete for attention with key inventory and summary.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse gaugeTone/theme tokens and existing MetricBar fill=solid for restrained categorical encoding, preserving labels/order/counts and descriptions.

visualIssues.detail: Revoke/delete ghost actions add neon hover backgrounds, overriding canonical neutral controls (second occurrence line 93).
visualIssues.fix: Prefer existing semantic/neutral Button treatment; preserve danger meaning, accessible names, disabled reason and pending state.

visualIssues.detail: Metadata divider is fixed border-white/[0.06], not a theme-aware border token. No literal pure-white text found in inspected feature presentation; fixed-white border remains theme-specific noise.
visualIssues.fix: Use canonical panel/default border variable; verify dark/light separation.

visualIssues.detail: Fixed cyan-300 decoration repeats on inventory, access, guidance and every guidance bullet (lines 187,227,232), irrespective of theme or meaning.
visualIssues.fix: Use muted/tokenized icons for supporting information while retaining meaningful icons and text.

architectureIssues.detail: APIKey.id is declared string while actual list wire id is int64 (handler.go:89). Current template URLs work for numeric runtime IDs, but generic typing does not establish the claimed string contract.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should reconcile existing wire and TypeScript identity contract and dependent hooks/tests without a speculative legacy adapter or backend cosmetic change.

architectureIssues.detail: Unknown permission falls back to Read, while summarizeKeys excludes it from known permission tallies (helpers.ts:56-57). Crash hardening is good, but unknown data can appear to have a known access level.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve own-key guard and graceful rendering; present unknown permission truthfully using existing Badge and localized copy, retaining raw inventory and known permission ordering.

architectureIssues.detail: String(count) overrides MetricBar's useNumberFormatting numeric readout with an unlocalized string.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the existing count formatter/readout instead of a competing formatter; preserve integer count meaning and progress values.

priority.rationale: Preserve already migrated layout/trust/write guards; address hidden capability failure, unknown-permission truth, mobile controls and restrained semantic presentation before cosmetic polish.
order: Resolve shared semantic presentation contracts without changing saved preferences.
Reconcile typed identity with integration owner.
Improve auth-mode source states and truthful permission/empty summary copy.
Subdue decorative color, parent opacity and theme-specific borders.
Run parent-owned focused and browser acceptance across states/themes/widths.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Reuse/extend subdued semantic Badge and IconBox presentation
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing Badge semantic variants and sizes; IconBox color/size/className currently neon-backed. Determine a theme-aware neutral/subdued icon/chip contract with readable text, icon+label, forced-colors and unknown state. Preserve existing consumers and persisted theme IDs; no new wrapper/registry.
dependsOn: Independent second production-consumer evidence before a new public API; this one-page audit does not establish whole-app demand
requiredSharedChanges.disposition: Shared owner review needed; existing Badge reuse may eliminate need for extension.

requiredSharedChanges.name: API key identity wire/type reconciliation
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Actual numeric list id versus declared string; preserve identity across list/card/revoke/delete, query invalidation and confirmation. Do not alter secret handling.
dependsOn: Existing snake_case plus camelCase alias client contract
Integration owner and focused hook/type regressions

competingImplementations.detail: Hand-composed permission chip overlaps shared Badge's semantic presentation. Domain metadata/icons remain local; consolidate presentation only if shared API preserves them.
Local permission fill palette overlaps existing gaugeTone owner. Domain permission order/labels are legitimate, not another application-wide status engine.

MaskedValue copyable plus adjacent CopyButton exposes two copy affordances. Preserve both until their actual accessibility and desktop/mobile intent are reviewed; no runtime duplication failure claimed.

sections.name: API key summary (Total, Active, Expired, Admin access)
Create key form and one-time generated-key reveal

actions: Trim name and generate Read/Read-write/Admin key
Forward-auth App sign-in forces Admin; unchecking returns Read
Masked reveal and copy, including reveal audit behavior
Revoke non-expired key with per-key pending indicator and sudo
Open named permanent-delete confirmation; confirm/cancel with pending and sudo
Retry fatal or retained inventory/permission source
Automatic write lock and dialog dismissal on operational mode change
dataBehavior: Preserve query key, safeArray normalization, cancellation and mutation invalidation/toasts.
Missing initial source is undefined, not fabricated zero; successful empty inventory counts remain zero.
Preserve expired-time calculation, active/admin/per-permission counts and all guidance.
Retained refresh failure must not destroy keys, metadata, counts, permission usage or delete target.
Preserve key name/prefix, created/last-used/never-used, expiry and optional app-owner subject.
No plaintext secret in inventory, persisted browser state or audit report; generated secret is local one-time presentation.
No wire/cache SI changes, legacy converters, selectors, route changes or migration rollback.
existingMigrationsToKeep: 44px card icon controls and own-property permission hardening

evidenceLimits.method: Read-only bounded source audit; only owned JSON report and heartbeat written. No Git, agents, HTTP requests, token/account mutations, dependency installation or UI/source edits.
evidenceLimits.runtime: Not exercised. Route mount citation is source registration, not navigation proof.
evidenceLimits.visual: No screenshots; saturation, glow, effective contrast and layout acceptance unverified. Inspected feature code uses no glow class; neonColorMap defines glow but inspected IconBox/permission badge consume bg/ring/text, not glow.
